findings.detail: Rows with blank issuer_name are non-position subtotal or rollup lines extracted into private_markets_holdings rather than issuer-bearing investments.

rationale: C201 flags issuer_name blanks in holdings rows. The raw schedule shows true investment rows carry issuer/company names in the first column, while the flagged blank-issuer pattern aligns with subtotal or rollup rows: blank first-column industry subtotals after issuer-bearing positions, Total Equity, Subtotal Controlled Investments, and Subtotal Cash Equivalents. These are not valid position identity rows and should have been filtered from private_markets_holdings, so the flag is a real data error caused by subtotal leakage. No aggregate anchor was needed for this Class 1 row-cell presence check.
